senses.gloss:
Sṛmara is the name of an unknown animal at the aśvamedha (‘horse sacrifice’) in the yajurveda Saṃhitās.
Foot notes taittirīya Saṃhita, v. 5, 16, 1 (according to Sāyaṇa = camara); Maitrāyaṇī Saṃhitā, iii. 14, 20; Vājasaneyi Saṃhitā, xxiv. 39 (where Mahīdhara identifies it with the gavaya).
